spell_changes.after_description:
Automatically unlocks poison applications as you level. No additional Ability Essence is required.

Level 20: Instant Poison
Level 20: Crippling Poison
Level 24: Mind-numbing Poison
Level 30: Deadly Poison
Level 32: Wound Poison
Level 60: Anesthetic Poison
